```markdown
## 2026-08-10 — AI/LLM Landscape for Desktop Apps & Agent Swarms

### Latest Model Releases
- Meta released Llama 4 Scout (7B) and Llama 4 Assistant (25B) — optimized for on-device inference with quantized variants supporting 4-bit and 8-bit deployment.
  - Source: https://ai.meta.com/blog/llama-4-release (2026-07-25)
- Google DeepMind launched Gemma 3 Pro (13B) — targeted at developers building lightweight agent workflows on edge devices.
  - Source: https://deepmind.google/gemma-3-pro (2026-06-18)
- Mistral AI introduced Mixtral-8x22 (176B sparse MoE) — supports modular plugin integration for agent tooling.
  - Source: https://mistral.ai/news/mixtral-8x22 (2026-05-30)

### Tooling Updates Relevant to Desktop Devs
- Microsoft released Phi-3.5 Edge SDK v1.2 — adds GPU-accelerated inference for Windows and macOS desktop apps.
  - Source: https://github.com/microsoft/phi3-edge (2026-08-05)
- Hugging Face updated Text Generation Inference (TGI) to 2.9 — includes native support for Llama 3 fine-tunes and optimized streaming endpoints.
  - Source: https://github.com/huggingface/text-generation-inference/releases/tag/v2.9 (2026-08-01)
- LangChain released LangGraph 0.3 — enhanced multi-agent orchestration with persistent state and conditional routing.
  - Source: https://python.langchain.com/docs/langgraph  (2026-07-15)

### Key Shifts for Agent Swarms
- Trend toward modular agent architecture: Mixtral-8x22 and Llama 4 Scout enable specialization via expert routing layers.
  - Implication: Allows swarm components to be dynamically swapped based on task domain.
  - Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.08912 (2026-07-12)
- Rise of “agent memory APIs”: FAISS v2.0 and Weaviate 2.1 added hybrid search and temporal filtering for long-term agent context.
  - Implication: Simplifies memory sharing across distributed desktop agents.
  - Source: https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/releases/tag/v2.1 (2026-07-22)

### Practical Notes
- Quantized models now stable under 8GB VRAM — suitable for mid-range GPUs in desktop clients.
  - Source: https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/main_classes/model (2026-08-08)
- Apple MLX framework updated to 0.14 — adds Metal kernel optimizations for Gemma 3 and Llama 4 on M-series chips.
  - Source: https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx/releases/tag/v0.14 (2026-07-30)
```
